description: Every zcxy-dev repository's dependency updates: extend github>zcxy-dev/renovate-config

packageRules.description: config:best-practices waits three days for npm releases; every repository waits seven
Patch and minor updates merge on their own once the required checks pass, through GitHub's auto-merge
An official image is rebuilt under the same tag every few days, so its digest would never come of age: digest updates of a tag already in use skip the wait

Node moves in one pull request everywhere it is named (the Docker image, .node-version, mise, engines), so files that must match never land apart. No seven-day wait: Docker Hub dates a tag by its last push, and the node images are rebuilt often enough that the image would never come of age and the group would never complete
@types/node follows the Node major: its major joins the Node.js group, without the wait so the group lands together, and waits for approval on the dashboard like every major
A Python minor (.python-version, the python image, mise) changes the interpreter the code runs on: it gets its own pull request, which waits for approval on the dashboard
A Playwright update needs the matching browser image and new screenshot baselines, so the packages and the image move together and never hold back the other updates
OpenNext supports a narrow range of Next.js versions, so Next.js, its @next packages and OpenNext move in one pull request
The shared workflows' pins (uses: zcxy-dev/dotfiles/.github/workflows/<name>.yml@<sha> # workflows-vX.Y.Z) move to a new release together, without the seven-day wait, since the releases are our own
